title: Negative-context gazetteer candidates
description: Candidate list of keywords whose presence in the surrounding context is designed to suppress a structurally valid detector match. Precedence-weight floor is 0.25 (context alone never fully suppresses a checksum-validated match). This artifact is build-and-freeze in Phase 2; the installed negative_context.json is a hand-reviewed subset.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

entries.description: Candidate entries in deterministic (keyword, category_scope, doctype_scope) order.

keyword.description: The trigger phrase. Stored lowercased; matched against normalized context tokens at detection time.

category_scope.description: Detector category this entry is designed to modulate.

doctype_scope.description: Document class in which the suppression applies. Keeps financial vocabulary from leaking into court-doc detection, and vice versa.

precedence_weight.description: Suppression strength in [0.25, 1.0]. The 0.25 floor preserves the invariant that context cannot fully override a checksum match.

source_id.description: Which source corpus the keyword came from. Resolves to a row in SOURCES.md.

rationale.description: One-line human-readable reason the keyword is designed to suppress this category in this doctype.
